title: 第903章 十万帝玄晶第902章 帝玄晶成
content_zh:
“成了！”
荒兽天帝始终在一旁，观看着苏辰的净化过程，只是没能看破其原理玄机。
尽管他心中怀揣着巨大的狐疑，但见苏辰真的成功将荒芜之气净化为帝玄晶，眼中还是流露出兴奋的光泽。
“这个人类小子的秘术，果然神奇！”
荒兽天帝刚刚，其实有一点欺瞒了苏辰。
净化荒芜之气，不是每一头荒兽都可以做到，而是只有拥有武帝实力的十阶以上荒兽，才拥有这个能力。
但就算是他亲自净化，也需要消耗大量的时间，至少比苏辰的净化过程要漫长几百倍。
这个过程中，会对他造成多大的压力，消耗多少精力，他都忽略不计。
最重要的是，其中几乎六七成的荒芜之气，都会在净化过程中逸散、流失，就这么白白浪费的，比成功净化出的还要多出将近一倍。
然而，目睹了苏辰净化的全程下来，荒兽天帝惊喜地发现，经这小子之手转化的荒芜之气，不仅速度快得惊人，过程中更是没有任何逸散，没有浪费一滴元力。
如此算下来，等到苏辰将他的荒芜之气全部净化为帝玄晶，即便分给这小子三成，这笔买卖对他来说也是稳赚不亏！
成功将荒芜之气凝炼为帝玄晶后，苏辰便立刻收入天机宝玉空间中，继续着手净化其他荒芜之气。
荒兽天帝心中欢喜激动的同时，两眼仍然死死盯着苏辰，集中全部精神力仔细观察，迫切地想要看破苏辰净化荒芜之气的玄机。
如果自己能够剖析并掌握这门秘术，便不再需要这个小子，可以自己来进行净化，免去白白分给苏辰三成的肉疼。
苏辰当然注意到，荒兽天帝始终用阴恻恻的目光凝视着自己，心中暗暗冷笑不已。
“我才刚开始炼化，就想着要卸磨杀驴了？真是头狡猾的老狐狸。”
荒兽天帝的心思，苏辰又怎会不知道，一旦被这家伙掌握了他净化荒芜之气的能力，那他就算能和雪儿躲在天机宝玉中活命，也不会有半分好处可捞。
但即便如此，苏辰也没有丝毫隐藏，坦然在荒兽天帝的注视下，继续重复进行着净化和凝炼的过程。
他所使用的净化之法，可是《太上武神诀》，岂是这么容易被看透的？
就算是自己目前为止接触过的最强者，师父叶逍遥，看破了他身上绝大多数秘密，却也对《太上武神诀》一无所知，何况是一头武帝级别的荒兽？

别说在他的面前演示让他看，就算自己手把手教给他，他也不可能学得会！
苏辰净化荒芜之气，荒兽天帝注视，洛雪儿则在天机宝玉空间内焦急等待。
帝殿内一改前几日剑拔弩张气氛，竟然变得出奇和谐。
眨眼间，便是三天的时间过去。
随着最后一缕荒芜之气净化凝炼为帝玄晶，被收入天机宝玉空间内，苏辰才微微吐出一口浊气，终止运转《太上武神诀》。
连续维持整整三天，也是对身体造成了不小的压力。
content_en:
"It's done!"
The Desolate Beast Emperor was always on the sidelines, watching Su Chen's purification process, but failed to see through the mystery of its principle.
Even though he had huge suspicions in his heart, his eyes still shone with excitement when he saw that Su Chen had successfully purified the desolate air into Emperor Xuan Crystal.
"This human boy's secret technique is indeed magical!"
The Desolate Beast Emperor actually deceived Su Chen a little bit just now.
Not every desolate beast can purify the desolate air, but only desolate beasts of level ten or above with the strength of the Martial Emperor have this ability.
But even if he purified it himself, it would still take a lot of time, at least hundreds of times longer than Su Chen's purification process.
He ignored how much pressure this process would cause him and how much energy it would consume.
The most important thing is that almost 60 to 70% of the desolate energy will escape and be lost during the purification process. What is wasted in this way is nearly twice as much as what is successfully purified.
However, after witnessing the entire process of Su Chen's purification, the Desolate Beast Emperor was pleasantly surprised to find that the desolate energy transformed by this boy's hands was not only incredibly fast, but also did not escape during the process, and not a drop of energy was wasted.
Calculated in this way, when Su Chen purifies all his desolate energy into Emperor Xuan Crystal, even if he gives this boy 30%, this deal will be a sure profit for him!
After successfully condensing the desolate energy into the Emperor Xuan Crystal, Su Chen immediately put it into the Tianji Baoyu space and continued to purify other desolate energy.
While the Emperor of the Desolate Beast was feeling happy and excited, his eyes were still fixed on Su Chen, concentrating all his energy to observe carefully, eager to see through the mystery of Su Chen's purification of the desolate energy.
If he could analyze and master this secret technique, he would no longer need this boy, and he could perform the purification by himself, sparing Su Chen 30% of the physical pain.
Of course, Su Chen noticed that the Desolate Beast Emperor was always staring at him with sinister eyes, and secretly sneered in his heart.
"I just started refining, and now I want to kill the donkey? What a cunning old fox."
How could Su Chen not know the thoughts of the Desolate Beast Emperor? Once this guy mastered his ability to purify the desolate air, even if he and Xueer could hide in the Tianji Baoyu to survive, there would be no benefit at all.
But even so, Su Chen did not hide it at all, calmly continuing to repeat the process of purification and condensation under the gaze of the Desolate Beast Emperor.
The purification method he used, the "Tai Shang Martial God Technique", was so easy to see through?
Even though Master Ye Xiaoyao, the strongest person he has come into contact with so far, has seen through most of his secrets, he still knows nothing about the "Tai Shang Martial God Art", let alone a desolate beast at the level of a Martial Emperor?
Let alone demonstrate it in front of him, even if you teach him step by step, he won't be able to learn it!
Su Chen purified the desolate air, while the Desolate Beast Emperor watched, while Luo Xueer waited anxiously in the Tianji Baoyu space.
The tense atmosphere in the Imperial Palace in the past few days has changed and it has become surprisingly harmonious.
In the blink of an eye, three days passed.
As the last ray of desolate energy was purified and condensed into the Emperor Xuan Crystal, which was collected into the Tianji Baoyu space, Su Chen let out a breath of turbid air and stopped running the "Tai Shang Martial God Art".
Maintaining it for three consecutive days also puts a lot of pressure on the body.
